title: Mixing: Meat City by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

The ninth of 17 mixing sessions for John Lennon’s fourth solo album Mind Games took place on 31 August 1973.

The album sessions all took place at New York’s Record Plant studio. On this day ‘Meat City’ was worked on. It was the second of four mixing sessions for the song; the others were on 24 August and 7 and 9 September.

Mixing sessions for Mind Games ran from 15 August to 14 September 1973.
